preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 668.
The length of the permutation n must be between 2 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p[i] <= n for i in range(n)) and len(set(p)) == n
preconditions.description: The permutation p must contain distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: len(p_prime) == n and all(1 <= p_prime[i] <= n for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output permutation p' must have the same length n and contain distinct integers from 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: sorted([p_prime[i] + p_prime[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1)]) == sorted([p[i] + p[i + 1] for i in range(n - 1)])
postconditions.description: The fingerprint of the output permutation p' must be the same as the fingerprint of the input permutation p.

postconditions.expression: any(p_prime[i] != p[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: The output permutation p' must be different from the input permutation p.
